stories.title: Kroger's Pappy Van Winkle bourbon lottery returns Black Friday
stories.summary: The lottery gives bourbon lovers, or enthusiasts, a chance to purchase a 10 year old or older bottle of Pappy Van Winkle Bourbon.

stories.title: Southern Indiana man arrested in fatal shooting of Louisville teenager
stories.summary: Brandon Bruin Jr., 20, faces murder and firearms charges in the July 2025 shooting death of 16-year-old Airean Carr.

stories.title: Georgia man arrested after escaping custody in Adair County
stories.summary: A Georgia man has been arrested after escaping custody while being transported to the Adair County Detention Center.

stories.title: Woman killed, man seriously injured in crash on Dixie Highway
stories.summary: A 38-year-old died at the scene after a pickup truck collision near Camping Circle Friday night. The driver was airlifted to the hospital.

stories.title: Fire contained at vacant home in Louisville's Russel neighborhood
stories.summary: Louisville firefighters brought the fire under control in about 22 minutes, preventing significant damage to neighboring properties.

stories.title: LMPD needs your help identifying two men involved in Bardstown Road shooting
stories.summary: Surveillance footage posted by LMPD shows the shooting happen and others in the area ducking for cover.

stories.title: Body found in alley near west Louisville Kroger, cause of death unknown
stories.summary: MetroSafe says that the report for the dead body came in around 5:37 p.m.

stories.title: Louisville teachers union demands higher wages as JCPS faces budget struggles
stories.summary: The Jefferson County Teachers Association is asking for teachers to be paid more next school year, to better reflect the cost of living.

stories.title: LMPD: 80 stolen water bottles recovered in Kentucky shoplifting investigation
stories.summary: Louisville Metro Police said they were investigating multiple shoplifting cases that involved the theft of OWALA water bottles from retailers.

stories.title: Woman arrested weeks after indictment in fatal Trimble County crash
stories.summary: Mary May was indicted weeks after being released from jail, and a warrant was issued for her arrest Nov. 6.

stories.title: I-65 off-ramp, downtown Louisville underpass expected to reopen; here's when
stories.summary: While no new local street or ramp closures are expected this year, drivers are warned intermittent lane closures could still happen.
